pins.title: Things to Do on the Chesapeake Bay: Crabbing, Kayaks, Sauna
pins.description: Things to do at a Chesapeake Bay cottage: pull a crab pot at dawn, paddle a sheltered creek in the kayaks, and finish with a cedar sauna and a cold plunge.
pins.altText: A wooden dock with pilings stretching out over calm, pale creek water in daylight.
pins.keywordVariant: things to do on the Chesapeake Bay

pins.title: Birding on Virginia's Northern Neck: Ospreys, Herons, Eagles
pins.description: Birding on Virginia's Northern Neck starts at the dock: an osprey on a bare snag over the water, with herons and eagles in the same view. Bring binoculars.
pins.altText: An osprey perched on top of a bare, pale snag beside green trees, with open water and a sandbar behind.

pins.title: Cabin Weekend Activities: Kayaks, Crab Pot, Sauna and Fire Pit
pins.description: Cabin weekend activities that keep the phone in the drawer: kayaks, a crab pot, a cedar sauna with a cold plunge, and a fire pit, on the Virginia Chesapeake.
pins.altText: Top half: a long dock over a calm creek. Bottom half: an osprey on a bare snag above open water.
